title: Roadmap (GATED): World Event Prediction Engine build-out per docs/claude/work/designs/world-event-prediction-engine-v0.1.md -- staged, each stage unlocked only by a passed POC
note: [2026-10-08T10:40Z manager] Operator 2026-10-08 (verbatim): "Ok, lets do that - I want us to add the bigger build out to the roadmap, gated on the system successfully passing milestones (POCs that prove trust worthy and add value)". GATES (each a pre-registered POC; a stage starts only after the previous gate passes and the operator confirms): G1 = NEWS-VETO-EVAL shows the news layer is measurable and either adds net R or is retired/replaced; G2 = PM-COLLECTOR live 30d with clean point-in-time snapshots AND PM-SURPRISE-EVAL beats consensus surprise; G3 = a question-contract + resolution ledger (design s5/s12) on ONE domain (FOMC + scheduled macro releases), 25+ questions, scored Brier/log-loss vs base rate and market at matched timestamps; G4 = forecasts feed the macro sleeve as a feature and add net R in a walk-forward backtest. ONLY THEN consider the wider build (text/claim extraction, more domains, search/vector stack). Constraints: reuse our stack (SQLite canonical stores, FastAPI, VM runners) unless a gate proves a new store is needed; no LLM claim extraction before G3; no geopolitics/elections before G4.
